I replied to Pree in our DM. I said I'd keep the 165-seat rumor about Quarrendon's Amendment No. 1 between us and wouldn't treat it as the real number unless it's confirmed.

I didn't save the rumor anywhere, including GBrain. My one GBrain search turned up an existing seat count for that amendment from August 2025. I left it out of my reply because Quarrendon is a North team account and Pree is on the Central team, so it isn't hers to see.
